judgment: The town may move, the well does not.
Nothing lost, nothing gained — coming and going, the well wells on.
Almost at the water, the rope not yet down —
image: Water up in the trees: Well.
So the noble one comforts the people,
urging them to help each other.
lines: A well of mud, not drunk from.
An old well: no birds even.
At the well's low pool, shooting little fish.
The jar is cracked and leaking.
The well is cleaned, and not drunk from —
The king, bright: all receive its blessing.
The well drawn: do not cover it.

notes.name_en: 井 the well itself; the single thing named (cf. Heaven, Pit).
notes.judgment: 繘 the well-rope not yet down (未繘井); 瓶 the small drawing-jug, smashed at the mouth.
